statement: A functional stereo/mono gadget audio profile does not establish the DualShock 4 USB audio class, interface topology, speaker routing or actual headset-microphone exposure. No matching host-device outcome is established for a composite gadget.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: DualShock 4 physical audio topology not measured by this research; no host test.
